collect.says: Fọm nke nchịkọta a, n’ịntanetị, nke onye ọ bụla nwere njikọ ya nwere ike idejupụta. Azịza ọ bụla na-abịa ebe a dị ka ahịrị.
collect.hint: Otu oghere maka kọlụm ọ bụla ị kara akara. Ndị ọzọ na-anọgide bụrụ nke gị.
collect.unsent: Enweghị ike iziga ya. Nwaa ọzọ.
collect.sealed: A na-etinye azịza n’akara n’ihe nchọgharị nke onye ọbịa, ya mere onye nnabata enweghị ike ịgụ ya.
